correctness.rationale: Headline was honestly downgraded from degree<=14 minimality to degrees<=12 census+minimality plus 13/14 witnesses. Auditor independently re-executed the exact certificate chain: --pisot-only replays all 13 stored Pisot D-records (11 at 2..12 plus F13/F14) from stored rationals only (Rouche inequality, disjointness, strict in/out location, Sturm count 1 on (1,2), opposite-sign bisection enclosure) with VERIFY_OK; --check-identity validates corrected Chebyshev R,S tables by |P(i)|^2 identity on 510 patterns; --tally re-derives every degree slice 2..12 from scratch (E1 endpoint + G separable-Sturm circle exclusion + D Rouche-disk counting) with F=0 and exact match to stored tallies (2: D2/G2; 3: D4/G0/E1-4; 4: D12/G4; 5: D12/E1-20; 6: D56/G8; 7: D64/G12/E1-52; 8: D188/G68; 9: D260/E1-252; 10: D992/G32; 11: D1160/G164/E1-724; 12: D4032/G64; sums equal 2^n, pisot=1 at mask 2^n-1 each). Method is sound: E1/G exclusion is complete for circle roots, D-route Rouché bound K=Sum k(k-1)/2|p_k|(|c0|+RF)^{k-2} with |P'|RF>|P(c0)|+KRF^2 gives exactly one root/disk, plus disjointness and count==n certifies (N_in,N_out); Sturm==1 on (1,2) forces the unique outside root real in (1,2). Minimality: phi enclosure width ~8.27e-25 (<1e-24) and every other degree<=12 house lo strictly exceeds phi hi (gap >0.22 at n=3, increasing toward 2). Monic +-1 enumeration (2^n masks/degree) is complete up to irrelevant global sign. Numpy used only for untrusted guesses. Proof (exact rational certificates, machine-checked) is distinguished from numerics.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors checked substantively against full text/abstracts: Hare-Jankauskas arXiv:1910.13994 proves Newman N(f)=k existence for n>=7, k in [3,n-3] (Littlewood less complete), answers Boyd degree-38 question, and explicitly leaves exceptional columns k in {1,2,3,n-3,n-2,n-1} unproved -- the N=n-1 Pisot column is therefore open, and its Prop 2.6 (Mukunda) gives only existence of one (1,n)/(n-1,n) pattern, not per-degree uniqueness (=exactly one) nor minimal-house ordering nor E1/G/D tallies; Bedert arXiv:2312.04454 counts unimodular zeros of the reciprocal subclass (minimum -> infinity), disjoint from nonreciprocal N_on=0 Pisot patterns; Drungilas et al. arXiv:1801.07179 exhausts +-1 through degree 12 only for the divisibility question (which Littlewood divide Newman), an unrelated invariant silent on Pisot status/house; Yakir arXiv:2011.06234 gives typical n/2+o(n) inside-disk counts for almost all Littlewood, implying nothing about extremal N=n-1 column or least house. PisotNumber MathWorld confirms golden-ratio/plastic-constant background and small-Pisot program without tabulating Littlewood-restricted Pisot counts or house minima. No source records or mechanically implies 'exactly F_n per degree 2..12 + phi minimal with >0.22 gap + enclosed F13/F14 witnesses'. Timestamp/failed-search not used as evidence.

value.rationale: Strongest self-contained headline judged separately from unfinished 13/14 survey (honestly labelled witness-only): exact invariant (Pisot root-location count + house/Mahler value) of a natural object (monic +-1 polynomials L_n) motivated before computation by the Lehmer/Smyth small-measure and Boyd Pisot programs and the Hare-Jankauskas N=n-1 column at the theory-given Barker-13 transition window. Value (unique Pisot pattern F_n=x^n-x^{n-1}-...-1 per degree 2..12; least house phi with certified gap; enclosed F13/F14 houses ~1.9998778327/~1.9999389387) was not known or mechanically implied and is directly consumable by Boyd tables and N=n-1-column users. This is a narrow exact datum but passes the stated standard for a rigorously established exact invariant of a motivated object; it is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration (tallies carry per-pattern E1/G/D certificates and a minimality verdict with interpretation). Incomplete 13/14 census is described honestly and does not erase the degree<=12 headline.

residual_risks: Verifier shares one R/S/Sturm/Rouché implementation between search and replay; systematic formula error would be self-consistent -- mitigated by independent |P(i)|^2 identity, full from-scratch tally re-derivation, and standard-formula review, but not by a second independent codebase.

G-route soundness depends on separable-part Sturm implication (G root in (-1,1) => circle root); direction used for exclusion was reviewed but no separate formal proof artifact is shipped beyond the code.
Degrees 13-14 completeness explicitly not claimed; any downstream use must cite minimality only through degree 12.
